pr_body:
These are the changes requested by @DaanDeMeyer  from comment https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/28480#issuecomment-1657980441

Fixes #28223, supersedes #28480.
pr_comments: Thanks for all the feedback from you. It's very much appreciated and very welcoming.

I think I need to add `inst_binary veritysetup` to `test/TEST-58-REPART/test.sh` to make the CentOS CI builds pass on ArchLinux. A little help would be appreciated. I believe I can ping @mrc0mmand to assist?

```diff

--- a/test/TEST-58-REPART/test.sh
+++ b/test/TEST-58-REPART/test.sh
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ test_append_files() {
         instmods dm_verity =md
         instmods erofs
         generate_module_dependencies
+        image_install veritysetup
         image_install -o mksquashfs
         image_install -o mkfs.erofs
     fi
```

I can't determine why the mkosi test failed from the output. The CentOS CI issue is due to failures in `testcase_copy_blocks()` which is before the test case for this change.

issue_context.title: systemd-repart: Support changing verity block and hash sizes using an environment variable
issue_context.body:
### Component

systemd-repart

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

Currently the block size and hash size for a generated verity partition is set based on the `--sector-size` argument or the detected sector size. A larger block size is useful to reduce the total size of the generated verity partition. For a 15GB partition this can drop the size from around 1GB using 512 byte sectors to ~115MB using 4K byte sectors.

### Describe the solution you'd like

An environment variable `SYSTEMD_REPART_VERITY_SECTOR_SIZE` or something similar that overrides the block and hash sizes. Perhaps two variables makes sense and whatever name is decided on really doesn't matter that much.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

Changing the sector size for the entire generated image. This does work but FAT 32 images do not like 4K sectors. There's also a bug currently (#28225) when using a larger sector size and deferred partitions.

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

commit 6cc0fd0044f3a6247f80388b653fc1b09784805d (253)

review_comments: We shouldn't parse arbitrary sizes here if only some very specific bytes values are applicable here. I would make this more similar to parse_sector_size(). In fact, aside from logging, it can probably be identical to it.
I've tried to combine `parse_sector_size()` and `config_parse_size4096()`. It needed a couple of changes.
After all the feedback from @poettering I think this one is probably as it should be.
Actually this doesn't work, `fs_sector_size` isn't yet initialized properly by the time we read the configuration. Please move this logic to `partition_format_verity_hash()`
I know it isn't obvious from the patch, but those changes are in `partition_format_verity_hash()`.
